result.summary: Several layout overflow and clipping issues make restaurant names and category chips look broken, plus a likely truncated restaurant title.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right edge, so 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and part of the image is clipped.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough peek/padding, or wrap/ellipsize names so cards don’t overflow the screen.

issues.description: The cuisine filter chips overflow the right edge; 'Healthy' is partially cut off and the next chip is barely visible.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll insets or fade so the last visible chip isn’t clipped.

issues.description: The featured restaurant name appears truncated as 'Tokumaru Ramer' instead of a complete name like 'Tokumaru Ramen'.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap or use a larger text area so the full restaurant name is shown.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant details under that card are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so cards can scroll fully into view.
